clock.encoding: little-endian binary on fixed one-cell tapes

control.fast_completed: emit source; advance both heads; reload clock; stay FAST
control.fast_tick: emit zero; advance physical head; reload clock; enter SLOW
control.slow_completed_equal: emit source; advance both heads; reload clock; enter FAST
control.slow_other_no_tick: advance simulated head iff source completed; stay SLOW
control.slow_other_tick: emit zero; advance physical head; advance simulated head iff source completed; reload clock; stay SLOW
